tara.design: Quick a11y review request — new toast/snackbar for model run completion on dark theme. Updated visuals attached. Need guidance on screen reader announcement, keyboard focus handoff, and skiplink interplay. TL;DR: actionable toast (View output) + minimal animation. olivia.a11y: Quick notes: if it’s actionable we should make it programmatically focusable on open. Screen readers are hit-or-miss for non-focusable aria-live changes. matt.eng: We intentionally avoided focus steal before — most toasts were purely informative. This one has a CTA so we made it interactive. Current plan: toast appears, auto-dismiss after 10s, Esc closes. olivia.a11y: For interactive toasts: set role="status" (or "alert" if urgent) AND move focus to the first focusable control inside the toast when it appears. Save the element that triggered the toast and restore focus on close. Also ensure aria-live isn't the only mechanism for important actions. sam.frontend: Agree. Proposed implementation snippet (rough): ```html

Notification: Model run complete

Result ready • 4 files
// JS focus management const toast = document.getElementById('run-toast'); const trigger = document.activeElement; toast.querySelector('.toast-cta').focus(); // on close: trigger.focus(); ``` sam.frontend: I'll make the toast element tabindex=-1 so we can focus if needed (and not trap tabbing). sarah.pm: Copy tweak: instead of "Model run complete" can we make it more contextual? e.g., "Result ready — Summarizer v2" + CTA "View results". Short and actionable. olivia.a11y: Also contrast: current mock uses bg #1b1b1f and body text #e6e6e6 — that’s ~4.2:1, below WCAG 2.1 AA for normal text (4.5:1). For body copy either lighten text to ~#f2f2f2 or darken bg slightly. Buttons should have >=3:1 for focus ring when using large UI components. matt.eng: We can bump text to #f4f4f4. Will that hit 4.5:1? If not I’ll try #fafafa. olivia.a11y: #f4f4f4 on #1b1b1f is ~4.4:1 (still borderline). #fafafa would be ~4.7:1 which is safe. For CTA background vs text check ratio too (button label over CTA bg). tara.design: Noted — I’ll update the mock to use #fafafa for the copy and tweak CTA colors. Also: animation — keep fade subtle and 200ms to avoid confusing SR users. Add reduced-motion preference. sam.frontend: On keyboard flow: ensure Tab from header skiplink/notifications lands into toast if it’s visible and actionable. We currently have a skiplink "Skip to notifications" in header — it needs to be visible on focus (not just on hover). Use .sr-only visible-on-focus pattern. olivia.a11y: Yes — skiplink is fine but avoid automatically moving focus to toast unless user navigates there. Only move focus to toast when it appears as a result of a user action (e.g., they clicked "Run") OR when the toast requires immediate action. Auto-focus on system-initiated toasts can be disruptive. matt.eng: Good nuance. For this feature the toast appears after user clicks "Run" in the UI, so auto-focus is acceptable since the user initiated that flow. We'll implement focus restore on close. sam.frontend: I’ll add tests: one unit test for focus restore, one e2e to assert aria-live message present. Add axe assertions for contrast. olivia.a11y: Also add a visually-hidden preface to the toast message like "Notification:" so SR users get context. And ensure aria-atomic true so updates are read fully. sarah.pm: UX question: should we surface a "View results" keyboard shortcut in the toast (hint text) or rely on Tab to get to button? Keep it discoverable but not noisy. tara.design: Maybe show a subtle hint: "Press Enter to open" in the toast for keyboard users — accessible text only for screen readers. olivia.a11y: Fine if hint is sr-only. But don't double-bind Enter globally; handle keydown on focused toast element. matt.eng: I'll review the focus-handling PR once Sam pushes it. Sam — can you include a small integration test that simulates a keyboard user running a job and consuming the toast? sam.frontend: Yep. Pushing branch later today: feat/ui/toast-a11y. Will ping here with PR link. :rocket: tara.design: Thanks all — will update mock and copy, then Sam will implement. Leaving this thread open until PR merged. :thumbsup:
